page.content:
Blade runner pulled back to retire Roy Batty's group.

How Rick Deckard connects

  • Creator: Harrison Ford — Harrison Ford played Rick Deckard.
  • Work: Blade Runner (1982) — The 1982 film is Deckard's hunt through Los Angeles 2019.
  • Faction: Blade Runners — Deckard is a blade runner pulled back onto the job.
  • Character: Roy Batty — Deckard's hunt ends in Roy's rooftop mercy.
  • Weapon: Voight-Kampff — Deckard administers the Voight-Kampff to Rachael.
  • Creator: Ana Stelline — Ana is Deckard and Rachael's hidden child.
  • Character: Rachael — Deckard leaves the city with Rachael.

What is Rick Deckard?

Rick Deckard is the tired hunter who tests Rachael, kills among Roy's circle, and later hides with the question of his own nature unanswered.

Key threads lead to Harrison Ford, Blade Runner (1982), Blade Runners, Roy Batty, Voight-Kampff and Ana Stelline.
